scope: exploratory comparison on already used supervised development groups
design: for each original/new leaf support and original/new risk fit, fit the E02 base and augmented risk models to the registered 128 groups. Use the other disjoint 128 fit groups plus the first 96 natural groups as a 224-group mock calibration cohort. Evaluate selected candidates on the second natural 96 and the balanced 56.
interpretation: common policies and budget within each cell. Families evaluated separately. All calibration/assessment images are documented historical dev cases; no formal certificate or new model selection.
